expected_rate: every 15-minute options refresh during RTH (GEX [COIN]) and every Track B tick in its window (EWY screen line)
window_reason: both lines are written on every refresh / Track B tick of a normal session, so one session is enough.
reversal: any of the 18 names missing from the writer's GEX lines or from the runner's DECISION / TRACK-B SCREEN lines in a full session; Track B tick-budget or api_budget deferrals rising above the 9 in 4,270 ticks measured before the change; or an added name's Day mean R from fills below -0.3R after 20 trades (owner decides removal).
